capabilities: Draw pen and highlighter annotations on PDF pages
Add text, cover, and image overlays with editable saved metadata
Export burned-in PDF, DOCX, PPTX, PNG, and HTML copies
Convert PDFs to Markdown with NoteDraw-aware editable elements
Automate annotation inspection and edits via a local PdftionAI API
disambiguation: Not a full low-level PDF object editor; it keeps editable annotation overlays beside the PDF and only rewrites the file for burned-in exports.
extras: Install is manual (copy release files into .obsidian/plugins/pdftion/); the plugin includes configurable payment QR codes (Alipay, Binance) and the marketplace listing notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF viewing offers only passive reading and basic text selection, without editable drawn annotations or visual export of annotated pages.
summary: PDF annotation plugin that adds editable ink, highlights, text and image overlays to PDF views, plus burned-in PDF, DOCX, PPTX, PNG, HTML and Markdown export.
